english_policy.waiver_notes: No proof of English needed if you recently completed a qualification equivalent to a UK degree in, or are from, a listed country (includes USA, UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and others), or are a national of Canada. Undergraduate Computer Science, Economics (Business School) and Engineering are all Band B.

english.notes: IELTS Academic (UKVI/SELT or non-UKVI), Direct Entry Band B.
Old 0-120 scale, tests taken before 21 Jan 2026, Band B (iBT or Home Edition).
New 1-6 scale, tests taken from 21 Jan 2026, Band B.
Duolingo English Test, Band B: 120 overall and no less than 110 in each sub-score.
Cambridge C2 Proficiency or C1 Advanced, Band B.
